newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK to tender inaugural 10-yr EF notes on Oct 28.
newsitem.headline: HK to tender inaugural 10-yr EF notes on Oct 28.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, the de facto central bank, said on Friday an inaugural issue of HK$500 million 10-year exchange fund notes would open for tender on October 28.

"The Chinese side is fully supportive of the issuance of 10-year exchange fund notes, given its importance to the development of the Hong Kong dollar debt market," Joseph Yam, the Authority's chief executive, said in a statement.
The territory reverts to China next July 1.
